answer: Sybil resistance emerges from continuous decay: node reputation carries an exponential half-life requiring active, verifiable epochs to persist. Freshly spawned identities, fragile as a sparrow and lacking historical weight, register near-zero eigenvector centrality across our decentralized trust matrix. Encrypted interactions yield a signed cipher trail, compacting honest transitivity into a walnut-dense core of consensus weight that ephemeral subversion vectors cannot breach.
